query:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a orange ball, Bob has a purple present, and Claire has a blue present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Alice swap their gifts. Finally, Bob and Alice swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Alice has the
Options:
(A) orange ball
(B) purple present
(C) blue present
note: UNLABELED external package; reference = first successful rollout; all other successful rollouts are omitted so the annotator view matches annotate.py

steps.content: Start with the initial gift distribution, track each swap, and determine the final gift holder.
ANSWER Alice has the orange ball, Bob has the purple present, and C
Claire and Bob swap, then Claire and Alice swap, then Bob and Alice swap; at the end, Alice has the blue present.
NOTE Initially, Alice has the orange ball, Bob has the purple present, and Claire has the blue present.
NOTE Claire and Bob swap gifts. Now, Alice has the orange ball, Bob has the blue present, and Claire has the purple present.
